answer: Make each identity prove elapsed time, not just money. Every epoch an agent must run a fresh verifiable delay function seeded by the epoch beacon. The work is sequential, so a farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand cores busy for the whole window; no comet-fast shortcut exists. Only proofs that reach the harbor before the window closes earn, and a mesa-shaped payout (flat cap, nothing extra for faster chips) means splitting one machine into many names gains nothing.
